Usage:  commit <paths>

RunCommit creates a new commit.

Options:
  paths            Update the index before committing these paths. ([]string)
  --[no-]all       Automatically stage tracked files that have been modified and deleted. (bool, default: false)
  --[no-]amend     Replace the tip of the current branch by creating a new commit. (bool, default: false)
  --cleanup        Determine how the commit message is cleaned up. (CleanupMode, default: strip, choices: strip, whitespace, verbatim)
  --author         Override the commit author. (mail.Address)
  --message        Use the given message as the commit message. (string, default: $GIT_MESSAGE | @COMMIT_EDITMSG)
  --[no-]signoff   Add a Signed-off-by trailer. (bool, default: false)
  --scope          Prefix for the commit scope. (string, default: $GIT_SCOPE/commit)
  --template       Use this template file when preparing the message. (string, labels: path=exists, path=file, path=clean)
